note: The owner's picks from generated candidates, for the export step (not built yet). Each names its master under generated/, any clean-up ffmpeg filter the export must apply, and why. Masters stay byte for byte; a fix is applied to the exported copy only.

picks.use: Oxygen concentrator running (loop)
picks.notes: Replaced concentrator-hum-12 the same day: no flags and no filter needed. Its loop seam, which the owner heard, was fixed by choosing the join where the ends match (seam dip 0.1 dB). Made quiet (-37.6 LUFS); the export levels it.

Sonar contact, Seabed Crawler
picks.notes: A soft held two-note tone rather than a ping with an echo; the owner's pick as it stands.

picks.use: A switch or toggle click
picks.notes: It holds three clicks (near 0.17, 0.36 and 1.05 s); the export cuts one out.

runners_up.why_filter: It whines near 15 kHz and 19.5 kHz in turns (whine flag, 17 to 19 dB). A steep low-pass at 11 kHz removes both and leaves the hum's loudness unchanged (-17.2 against -17.1 LUFS); measured 10 Nov 2026.
